verdict.rationale: Obsidian's core Daily Notes plugin opens/creates a note for today's date and can be paired with the Templates core plugin to pre-fill content, directly matching the story [obsidian-docs-4][obsidian-docs-5]. Community evidence corroborates daily notes as a common power-user workflow (mixed freely with folders/Zettelkasten) [obsidian-comm-4][obsidian-comm-17]. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation confirming daily note as the literal 'default landing/startup' page, and independent confirmation of template auto-fill reliability at scale.
